goal: Prevent peers from causing huge memory allocations and CPU spikes when deserializing witness stacks
Reject transactions and blocks exceeding physical size limits early before allocating vector memory
reviewability: Author pushed early weight budget rejection checks awaiting review
agreement: Strong support for mitigating exceptional transaction DoS vectors (instagibbs)
Concept approval without stated reasons (0xB10C, furszy, rkrux, w0xlt)

categories.name: p2p
why: P1 because it stops malicious peers from inducing unbounded memory allocations before validation rejects them
Tracks a weight budget over network streams to immediately drop oversized transactions and blocks

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it fixes a severe CPU and memory exhaustion vulnerability in block deserialization
Cuts worst-case block deserialization time from 279 ms to 19 ms and peak memory from 182 MiB to 7.8 MiB
